title: DNA Extraction, PCR Amplification, Sequencing and Phylogenetic Analysis
author: Jing Xu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jinckde
materials: The resulting pellet was collected by centrifugation (12,000×g, 15 min), washed twice with 75% ethanol, air-dried, resuspended in 20 μl of sterile Millipore water and deposited in -20℃ freezer for storage.
The amplified products were submitted for sequencing (Invitrogen, Shanghai)

steps.title: Culture fungal isolate
steps.instruction: Incubate the fungal isolate on PDA plates at 28 °C in darkness for 5–7 days.

steps.title: Lyse mycelia with CTAB
steps.instruction: Weigh 100 mg of fungal mycelia, place in a mortar, add 1000 µL of CTAB lysis buffer and grind while maintaining 65 °C.

steps.title: Add β‑mercaptoethanol and incubate
steps.instruction: Transfer the ground mixture to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 10 µL β‑mercaptoethanol, mix thoroughly, then water‑bath at 65 °C for 60 min with continuous shaking.

steps.title: Perform chloroform extractions
steps.instruction: Extract the lysate twice with an equal volume of chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1) by centrifuging at 12 000 × g for 8 min at 4 °C each time; transfer the supernatant to a new tube after each extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add equal volume of chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to lysate, mix, centrifuge 12 000 × g, 8 min, 4 °C.
Transfer supernatant to a new microtube.
Repeat the chloroform/isoamyl alcohol extraction once more under the same conditions.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add chilled isopropanol at twice the volume of the supernatant, mix, and incubate at –20 °C for 6 h.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix on ice
steps.instruction: On ice, combine the following in a tube to a final volume of 50 µL: 1 µL cDNA mixture, 1 µL dNTPs, 1 µL upstream primer (10 mM, ITS1F), 1 µL downstream primer (10 mM, ITS4), 5 µL Taq buffer, 1 µL Taq polymerase, and add nuclease‑free water up to 50 µL.

substeps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to reach 50 µL total volume.

steps.title: Add genomic DNA template
steps.instruction: Introduce the extracted genomic DNA (as template) into the prepared PCR master mix and mix gently.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler as follows: initial denaturation at 94 °C for 5 min; 30 cycles of 94 °C for 40 s, 55 °C for 40 s, 72 °C for 55 s; final extension at 72 °C for 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Edit ITS sequences with BioEdit
steps.instruction: Import the obtained ITS‑rDNA sequences into BioEdit 5.0.6 and remove cross‑peaks to obtain clean sequences.

steps.title: Identify homologs via BLAST
steps.instruction: Use the BLAST program to align the cleaned sequences against GenBank and record matches with ≥ 98 % similarity.

steps.title: Construct phylogenetic tree
steps.instruction: Import the aligned sequences into MEGA 5.1, generate a neighbor‑joining tree, and perform bootstrap analysis with 1 000 replications.

steps.title: Submit sequences to GenBank
steps.instruction: Upload the representative ITS‑rDNA sequences to GenBank and record the accession numbers assigned.
